tiers.name: Water trough and a lambing pen
A proper barn with a roof that keeps its tiles
Stud board, loose boxes and a vet on speed dial

events.line: A fox got in the night before and the hens, the ducks and your afternoon all went with it. The fence was mended by teatime.
A visiting breed judge leant on the gate for an hour and said "hm" four times. Three owners booked a stall before she left.
A heat wave. The stock stood under the one tree in a queue, and the water trough was drunk dry twice.
Lambing open day. Half the parish came for the lambs and stayed for the tea urn.
A wet week turned the gateway to soup. The boarders were unbothered and everyone else sulked.
The vet came out for a limp that turned out to be a stone. The bill for the stone was not small.
A hard frost split the trough. The ice came out in one piece and was admired for some time.
